scheme_name: Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities
description:
The Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2014. 

This initiative aims to provide free coaching to students with disabilities. 

The scheme is designed to enhance the educational opportunities for students with disabilities. 

It specifically targets those preparing for competitive examinations. 

The objective of this scheme is to empower students with disabilities. 

It seeks to enable them to compete on an equal footing with their peers. 

The scheme aims to provide quality coaching to students who may otherwise face barriers. 

The government has set a target to reach at least 10,000 students annually. 

This initiative is part of a broader commitment to inclusive education in India. 

The scheme covers various competitive examinations. 

These include examinations for civil services. 

It also includes examinations for engineering and medical colleges. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

Eligible students can receive up to INR 50,000 per annum. 

This amount is intended to cover coaching fees and related expenses. 

The scheme also provides for the purchase of study materials. 

This includes books and other necessary resources. 

Eligibility for this scheme is defined clearly. 

Students must have a recognized disability as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016. 

The disability must be certified by a competent authority. 

Students must be between the ages of 15 and 30 years. 

They must also be pursuing a recognized course of study. 

Income criteria are also specified under this scheme. 

The annual family income must not exceed INR 8 lakhs. 

This ensures that the benefits reach those who are in genuine need. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must fill out an online application form. 

This form is available on the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

Applicants must provide personal details and educational qualifications. 

They must also upload relevant documents. 

These documents include a disability certificate. 

They also need to include proof of income. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Successful applicants are notified through email or SMS. 

The disbursement of funds is typically done in a timely manner. 

Funds are released directly to the coaching institutes. 

This ensures that students do not face any financial hurdles. 

The timeline for application submission is usually announced annually. 

Typically, applications are accepted from January to March. 

Coaching institutes are also required to register under this scheme. 

They must meet specific criteria set by the government. 

This includes having qualified faculty and adequate infrastructure. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities oversees the execution. 

For further assistance, the Ministry can be contacted via their official helpline. 

The helpline number is 1800 11 55 55. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception. 

Many students with disabilities have benefited from the coaching provided. 

This has led to increased participation in competitive exams. 

The government has also conducted awareness programs. 

These programs aim to inform students about the scheme. 

They also educate parents and guardians about available opportunities. 

The scheme aligns with the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. 

It emphasizes the right to education for all individuals. 

The initiative has contributed to reducing educational disparities. 

It has also fostered a more inclusive society. 

The government continues to monitor the scheme's effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected regularly. 

This helps in making necessary adjustments to improve the program. 

The Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities scheme is a significant step. 

It reflects the government's commitment to social justice. 

The scheme plays a crucial role in empowering marginalized communities. 

It aims to create a level playing field for all students. 

The initiative is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes. 

These schemes are designed to uplift disadvantaged groups in India. 

The government remains dedicated to enhancing educational access. 

This ensures that every student has the opportunity to succeed. 

In conclusion, the Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities scheme is a vital program. 

It provides essential support to students with disabilities. 

The scheme not only offers financial assistance but also promotes inclusivity. 

It is a testament to the government's efforts in fostering equality in education. 

The ongoing success of this scheme will depend on continued support and awareness. 

This will ensure that more students can benefit from the opportunities provided.
